capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: Slot changes by other applicants, consulate cancellations and the appointment check happen only when Infra applies their events; the App never schedules itself.
The appointment check applies six rules to the facts the agent registered; VisaSlot does not read ConfDesk, Passage, hotel or airline records.
VisaSlot sends no mail in v1; appointments and results are read in the portal.
No visa decision, biometrics, fees, photos, insurance or funds checks; checklist items without a rule are checked in person and not modelled.
